value.description: Miao Yin the Panda By Christie Kotz ThePeachPeddler 15 inches (38.1 centimeters) Allow me to introduce my latest teddybear, "Miao Yin" (named after the character in Big Trouble in Little China) Here are a few details about this little lady: ~ She is made with Steiff Schulte Mohair (black parts including eye patches) and Alpaca (cream sections), fully lined with cotton backing ~ Blue handpainted glass eyes (by Edinburgh Imports) ~ 100% handsewn ~ Embroidered nose sealed with beeswax ~ Handshaded with artist oil paints to fill out the eye patches (which are inset black mohair pieces) and shade around the face ~ Ultrasuede pads with sculpted toes ~ Weighted with copper coated steel shot (in pouches to prevent the shot from wandering through the stuffing) - actual weight = 3.5 pounds ~ She is a sitting bear, and is not made to stand. I don't make many pandas, and very very rarely do the inset eye patches (versus painting/shading in the eye spots), so this girl is pretty special. :)

value.description: Miao Yin the Panda By Christie Kotz ThePeachPeddler 15 inches (38.1 centimeters) Allow me to introduce my latest teddybear, "Miao Yin" (named after the character in Big Trouble in Little China) Here are a few details about this little lady: ~ She is made with Steiff Schulte Mohair (black parts including eye patches) and Alpaca (cream sections), fully lined with cotton backing ~ Blue handpainted glass eyes (by Edinburgh Imports) ~ 100% handsewn ~ Embroidered nose sealed with beeswax ~ Handshaded with artist oil paints to fill out the eye patches (which are inset black mohair pieces) and shade around the face ~ Ultrasuede pads with sculpted toes ~ Weighted with copper coated steel shot (in pouches to prevent the shot from wandering through the stuffing) - actual weight = 3.5 pounds ~ She is a sitting bear, and is not made to stand. I don't make many pandas, and very very rarely do the inset eye patches (versus painting/shading in the eye spots), so this girl is pretty special. :)
